qualifier: from spindle midzone to midbody abscission
name: Cytokinesis from spindle midzone to midbody abscission
rationale: Members cover late mitotic division (midzone assembly, spindle elongation, contractile ring, cleavage furrow, septins, abscission, Rho GTPase cycle), whereas confusables centre on spindle checkpoint signalling or ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing.

name: Activating Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis
rationale: All members describe activating FCGR signalling driving phagocytic cup actin and phospholipid remodelling, distinct from inhibitory Fc receptor/SIRP signalling, hypersensitivity/ADCC, BCR or generic WASP-actin confusables.

qualifier: with Tfh help in germinal centres
name: B cell activation and Tfh help in germinal centres
rationale: Members combine B cell and memory B signatures with germinal centre B differentiation, Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, which the plasma-cell, naive-B and memory-response confusables lack.

name: Meiotic chromosome alignment and poleward segregation
rationale: All three members concern physical movement of meiotic chromosomes on the spindle, unlike confusables about meiotic checkpoints and transitions, chromosome condensation, or meiotic spindle positioning.

name: EGFR-centred ERBB signalling and its regulation
rationale: Members focus on EGFR (SHC1/GRB2 events, ERBB2-EGFR heterodimers, gastrin transactivation, overexpression inhibition), whereas confusables centre on ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4 effector events.

name: Glutamate and aspartate membrane transport and reuptake
rationale: Members are glutamate/aspartate transporters, reuptake and homeostasis including SLC1 and SLC17A8 disorders, distinguishing them from the GABA and glycine neurotransmitter confusables.

qualifier: switch between apoptosis and necroptosis via RIPK1/TRIF
name: Caspase-8/RIPK1 switch between apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover procaspase-8 dimerisation, c-FLIP and CASP8 inhibition, TRIF/TLR3 and RIPK1 necroptosis, unlike confusables about Fas/BID extrinsic apoptosis or TBK1-IRF3 signalling.

name: Nuclear pore complex-mediated mRNA export and gene tethering
rationale: Members centre on mature mRNA export through nuclear pores plus pore-associated transcriptional roles, distinct from RNA processing/decay, miRNA silencing, transcription machinery and rRNA/tRNA export confusables.

name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling via TRAF3/TRAF6 and viral evasion
rationale: Members describe RLR signalling to IRF and NF-kB through TRAF3/TRAF6 and its modulation by SARS-CoV and RSV, whereas confusables emphasise interferon production, ISG effectors or TBK1-IRF3 regulation.

qualifier: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid, with lipid transfer
name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and transfer
rationale: Members cover GPI synthesis/attachment, ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transfer, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, protein palmitoylation or lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism.

qualifier: de novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis and nucleotide catabolism
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis and nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis, UMP salvage and catabolism of pyrimidines and dNMPs, whereas confusables focus on deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion.

name: OATP-mediated drug and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic import/export, drug ADME and SLCO (OATP) organic anion transport including Rotor syndrome, distinct from organic cation/SLC22 transport, bilirubin conjugation and xenobiotic-metabolising enzyme confusables.

name: TCA-cycle-linked glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle, gluconeogenesis and pyruvate with glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism, unlike oxidative phosphorylation, dicarboxylate transport or broad amino acid catabolism/urea cycle confusables.

name: Centrosome duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members cover centriole duplication/cohesion, MTOC nucleation and anchoring, astral microtubules and spindle positioning in asymmetric division, distinct from neuroblast division, mitotic centrosome maturation, tubulin modification and cilia confusables.

name: Basement membrane assembly and collagen-laminin-integrin interactions
rationale: Members cover basement membrane assembly, laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerisation, oxidative crosslinking and collagen receptor signalling, unlike elastic fibre, hemidesmosome, dystroglycan or collagen biosynthesis confusables.

name: Calcium ATPase pump regulation in striated muscle fibres
rationale: Members regulate ATP-dependent calcium transport into the sarcoplasmic reticulum and across the plasma membrane with muscle fibre-type and apoptosis effects, whereas confusables concern cardiac contraction, heart rate and voltage-gated channels.

name: Hepatobiliary and intestinal lipid efflux by ABC transporters
rationale: Members cover ABCG5/8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 lipid efflux and their disorders plus intestinal lipid absorption, distinct from lipoprotein remodelling, bile acid synthesis and chylomicron assembly confusables.

name: Gonad and germ cell development with oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members cover germ cell migration and proliferation, follicle and seminiferous tubule development, FSH/LH responses and oocyte meiotic maturation, whereas confusables focus on ovulation/luteinisation, gonadotropin secretion or male sex determination.

name: Cadherin-based adherens junctions and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly/maintenance and apical-basal polarity, distinct from desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH1/CDH11 processing and tight junction confusables.

name: P450 and lipoxygenase oxygenation of arachidonate and fatty acids
rationale: Members cover CYP omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase routes, lipoxygenase HETE/hepoxilin/lipoxin synthesis and fatty acid transport, unlike leukotriene/cysteinyl-LT, PAF or omega-3 resolvin confusables.

name: Endosomal membrane tubulation and Golgi vesicle budding
rationale: All members concern shaping membranes into tubules or buds, whereas confusables cover Rab/ARF regulation, recycling and Golgi organisation.

name: Respiratory burst-driven neutrophil killing of bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members cover regulation of respiratory burst and superoxide and neutrophil killing of bacteria and fungi, distinct from degranulation, antimicrobial peptide/Gram-positive defence and PMN phagocytolytic confusables.

name: Bicarbonate transmembrane transport
rationale: All members concern bicarbonate transport, which the chloride/cation, SLC26 anion, ammonium/CO2 and CFTR confusables lack.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase-derived lipoxin biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover 5- and 15-HETE synthesis and lipoxin formation, unlike 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin, omega-3 resolvin and leukotriene confusables.

name: Cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K isoprenoid metabolism
rationale: Members span mevalonate-derived cholesterol and ubiquinol synthesis and vitamin K metabolism with its gamma-carboxylation role, distinct from vitamin E, sterol-disease CYP, vitamin K response and dolichol confusables.
